definitions.explanation: Being behind in development or progress.

examples.english: The train is running 5 minutes late.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦せい→せい：10469_sei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{飛行機|ひこうき}→飛行機：00629_hikouki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{遅|おく}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}ている→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: Flights are experiencing major delays because of the snow.

examples.japanese: ⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{遅|おく}れ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{戻|もど}す→取り戻す：04223_torimodosu⟧。
examples.english: To catch up on the technological lag.

examples.japanese: ⟦{勉強|べんきょう}→勉強：00770_benkyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{遅|おく}れ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{戻|もど}す→取り戻す：04223_torimodosu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{頑張|がんば}っている→頑張る：01222_ganbaru⟧。
examples.english: I'm working hard every day to make up for falling behind in my studies.

notes:
{遅|おく}れ is the noun form of the verb ⟦{遅|おく}れる→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧ (to be late/delayed). It refers to both being behind schedule and falling behind in progress.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {遅|おく}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: a delay occurs
- {遅|おく}れ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to fall behind (compared to others)
- {遅|おく}れ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{戻|もど}す→取り戻す：04223_torimodosu⟧: to make up for lost time, to catch up
- 〜⟦{分|ふん}→分：00928_fun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{遅|おく}れ: ~ minutes' delay
- {遅|おく}れ⟦{気味|ぎみ}→気味：27635_gimi⟧: slightly behind schedule

USAGE:
Often appears in transportation contexts (⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{遅|おく}れ, ⟦{飛行機|ひこうき}→飛行機：00629_hikouki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{遅|おく}れ) and in academic or professional contexts (⟦{勉強|べんきょう}→勉強：00770_benkyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{遅|おく}れ, ⟦{開発|かいはつ}→開発：06746_kaihatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{遅|おく}れ).

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{遅|おく}れる→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧: to be late, to be delayed (verb)
- ⟦{遅刻|ちこく}→遅刻：03465_chikoku⟧: being late (specifically for appointments/school/work)
